key_result: AI outages stall new trading code while deployed bots keep trading; execution stayed concentrated, with fifty addresses executing two thirds of verified MEV trades.
takeaway: Builds a registry of 5,868 outage incidents across 30 AI providers and pairs it with onchain trading data to see what outages change.
title: AIDA: An AI Outage Registry with Evidence from On-Chain MEV
why_it_matters: It is a dataset of when AI services fail, with an application to automated trading.
